verses.1:
For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. + 8:1 Gittith is probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in Psalms 81 and 84. A Psalm of David.
 O LORD, our Lord,
 how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
 You have set Your glory
 above the heavens.
verses.2:
From the mouths of children and infants
 You have ordained praise + 8:2 Literally You have ordained strength ; LXX You have prepared praise ; cited in Matthew 21:16|MAT 21:16 
 on account of Your adversaries,
 to silence the enemy and avenger.
verses.3:
When I behold Your heavens,
 the work of Your fingers,
 the moon and the stars,
 which You have set in place —
verses.4:
what is man that You are mindful of him,
 or the son of man that You care for him?
verses.5:
You made him a little lower than the angels; + 8:5 Or than God or than the heavenly beings ; see also LXX. 
 You crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.6:
You made him ruler of the works of Your hands;
 You have placed everything under his feet: + 8:6 Cited in 1 Corinthians 15:27|1CO 15:27 and Hebrews 2:6–8
verses.7:
all sheep and oxen,
 and even the beasts of the field,
verses.8:
the birds of the air and the fish of the sea,
 all that swim the paths of the seas.
verses.9:
O LORD, our Lord,
 how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
